stock.description: As an investment holding entity, Yuanda China Holdings Limited specializes in the comprehensive provision of curtain wall systems, encompassing their conceptualization, sourcing, manufacturing, assembly, sale, and installation. Its market reach extends across the People's Republic of China and into international territories. The company's diverse range of offerings includes specialized curtain wall designs such as double-skin, unitized, modular, and stick systems, along with point-fixing frameless glass and frameless-sides-fixing glass varieties. Beyond its core curtain wall products, Yuanda China also furnishes skylights, decorative components for curtain walls, breast board systems, canopies, and energy-efficient aluminum doors and windows. Additionally, it provides advanced solutions like solar-integrated curtain wall systems, sophisticated night scene lighting and video installations, and sun-shading and ventilation technologies. Founded in 1993, the enterprise maintains its principal office in Shenyang, PRC.
